text:
nina_se: Heads up 1 - our IdP cert (SAML signing cert) used by SSO expires in 10 days (2026-04-02). Dev and some service accounts still rely on the old metadata. Need coordinated rotation.

alex_idp: thanks for flagging. I'll publish new metadata to https://sso.redwood.com/.well-known/saml and notify SP owners.

maria_apps: which services are impacted? any downtime expected?

nina_se: primary impact: web console logins should be seamless if SP trusts new metadata, but some legacy apps pin the cert thumbprint or use a baked-in metadata file in their containers. Those will fail after rollover. Also a few integration service accounts use static SAML assertions.

ops-bot: [automated] Created ticket S-5480: "IdP cert rotate + update pinned metadata in apps" assigned to idp and app teams (P1).

alex_idp: rotation plan: 1) generate new keypair and cert 2) publish new metadata with validFrom today+1 3) keep old cert valid for 7 days overlap 4) notify owners and provide a signed metadata bundle.

maria_apps: I'll grep our images for the cert thumbprint and pinned metadata. Where can we find the old thumbprint?

nina_se: old thumbprint: 3A:4B:5C:6D:7E:8F:9A:0B:11:22:33:44:55:66:77:88:99:AA:BB. We'll add a script to CI to fail builds if that fingerprint is baked in.

security-bot: [automated] Scanning container registry for files matching 'saml-metadata.xml' and known thumbprints. ETA 25m.

alex_idp: mitigation steps for app teams: - stop using pinned metadata; pull from our well-known URL at startup - for short-term, accept both certs via metadata bundle - rotate any service accounts relying on static assertions to OIDC where possible.

maria_apps: noted. We have a legacy job that uses static SAML assertion to authenticate a headless service (svc-reporting). I'll migrate it to OIDC and request a short-lived key from secrets manager. ETA 48h.

nina_se: timeline: publish metadata tomorrow 2026-03-26 10:00 UTC, keep overlap until 2026-04-02, all pinned usages must be updated by 2026-04-01 EOD. Postmortem required only if any production outages occur.

ops-bot: [automated] Sent email to service-owners@redwood with rotation details and metadata bundle.

security-bot: [automated] Quick scan results: found 4 images with pinned metadata (apps: svc-reporting, legacy-ingest, analytics-worker, deploy-helper). Creating follow-ups under S-5480.

maria_apps: I'll take svc-reporting and deploy-helper. Tagging @platform for analytics-worker migration.

alex_idp: I'll post the signed metadata bundle in the ticket and include SHA256 and validity window. Contact me if you need help updating trust stores.

nina_se: thanks team. If you find any service accounts using static SAML assertions, tag me and we'll prioritize. Closing Slack thread; follow-ups in S-5480. :lock:
